comments.dependencies: Frontend vendor libraries served to the browser. The build.xml Ant target copies these from node_modules into resources/js/external.
comments.font-awesome: Consolidated onto @fortawesome/fontawesome-free@7.3.1 everywhere (previously split 4.7.0/5.7.2). css/v4-shims.min.css is loaded alongside all.min.css so the site's old v4-style `fa fa-x` markup keeps rendering without an icon-by-icon rewrite.
comments.d3: Two d3 majors are both in use: d3@5.16.0 (d3.v5) backs items/permanentItems; d3-v3 is an npm alias for d3@3.5.17 (d3.v3), used only by templates/sparql.html. Both kept, pinned, to preserve current per-page behavior.

scripts.deploy:dev: ant && EXISTDB_SERVER=http://localhost:8080 EXISTDB_USER=admin EXISTDB_PASS= xst package install local-files build/*.xar
